title: Patients aren’t doing their physical therapy homework | Medical Economics

hit.text: The survey of 1,006 Americans found that 76% did not complete all of their assigned at-home physical therapy exercises. Only 24% reported completing all prescribed sessions, while 28% completed 75% to 99%, 27% completed 50% to 74%, 11% completed 25% to 49%, 8% completed 1% to 25%, and 2% said they did none.
